name: ATMPIN Management Request V 03
definition: The ATMPINManagementRequest message is sent by an ATM to an ATM manager to request an operation on the cardholder PIN.

Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMPINManagementRequest.name: ATMPIN Management Request
